title: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs: Incorrect hop_count calculation in expanding ring scenarios
description: Line 564: `actual_hops = INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT.saturating_sub(rreq.hop_limit)` uses hardcoded INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT=4, but expanding ring sends RREQs with hop_limit 8 or 15 (EXPANDING_RING array). When hop_limit > 4, saturating_sub produces 0, giving wrong reverse route hop_count. Example: RREQ sent with hop_limit=8, received with hop_limit=6 after 2 hops, but calculation gives 4-6=0 instead of 2. The RREQ struct lacks an original_hop_limit field to compute this correctly.
